definitions.explanation: The act of dividing something into smaller, more manageable portions. Commonly used when packaging food or organizing items into smaller groups.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{小分|こわ}けにして⟦{配|くば}った→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: I divided the sweets into small portions and handed them out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{小分|こわ}けにして⟦{冷凍|れいとう}→冷凍：11730_reitou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I divided the leftover curry into small portions and froze them.

notes:
{小分|こわ}け means dividing something into smaller, manageable portions. Composed of ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) + {分|わ}け (dividing).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {小分|こわ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to divide into small portions
- {小分|こわ}けにして⟦{冷凍|れいとう}→冷凍：11730_reitou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to portion out and freeze
- {小分|こわ}け⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧: individual portion pack
- {小分|こわ}け{袋|ぶくろ}: small bag for portioning

USAGE:
- Cooking: dividing leftovers for freezing
- Gift-giving: portioning out sweets or snacks
- Organization: sorting items into smaller groups
- Shopping: individually packaged products

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to divide, to separate
- ⟦{取|と}り{分|わ}ける→取り分ける：22512_toriwakeru⟧: to divide up and distribute
- {一人分|ひとりぶん}: one person's portion
